notes: Refined existing stories to strengthen edge-case handling, fallback logic, and integration clarity. No new story IDs created.

change_log.value: Implement logic to compute distance and estimated travel time between user location and each clinical trial site, including normalization of inputs and fallback handling when coordinates are missing or partial.
Integrate Google Routes API to fetch real-world travel distance and duration, including handling API errors, rate limits, retries, and graceful degradation when the API is unavailable.
Extend evaluate_care_facade to include proximity metrics in clinical trial results, ensuring consistent response structure and compatibility with existing clinical trials output contract.

Create unit and integration tests validating distance and duration accuracy, handling of missing or invalid locations, API failure scenarios, and end-to-end propagation through the evaluate care facade.

EVAL-CT-M3-S1.title: Define Proximity Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M3-S1.description: Define structured schema for trial site proximity including distance (miles/km), travel duration (minutes), and origin/destination metadata.

EVAL-CT-M3-S2.title: Implement Distance and Travel Time Calculation Logic
EVAL-CT-M3-S2.description: Implement logic to compute distance and estimated travel time between user location and each clinical trial site, including normalization of inputs and fallback handling when coordinates are missing or partial.

EVAL-CT-M3-S3.title: Integrate Google Routes API for Travel Metrics
EVAL-CT-M3-S3.description: Integrate Google Routes API to fetch real-world travel distance and duration, including handling API errors, rate limits, retries, and graceful degradation when the API is unavailable.

EVAL-CT-M3-S4.title: Expose Proximity Data via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include proximity metrics in clinical trial results, ensuring consistent response structure and compatibility with existing clinical trials output contract.

EVAL-CT-M3-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Proximity Calculation
EVAL-CT-M3-S5.description: Create unit and integration tests validating distance and duration accuracy, handling of missing or invalid locations, API failure scenarios, and end-to-end propagation through the evaluate care facade.
